summary: Mutex wrapper method that conditionally closes a previously created mutex handle, then creates a new unnamed mutex via CreateMutexA and records validity. If the byte flag at this+0xC is set and CloseHandle succeeds, the handle at this+0x4 is cleared to 0. A fresh handle is always created with SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES (nLength=12, no descriptor, inherit=1) and stored at this+0x4; on success the flag at this+0xC is set to 1. The function returns the flag value.

operations.description: If byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero AND CloseHandle(handle at this+0x4) succeeds, the old mutex is considered closed.
Conditionally clear the handle field at this+0x4 to 0 after the previous handle was closed.
Initialize stack SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES: nLength=12, lpSecurityDescriptor=0, bInheritHandle=1.
Call CreateMutexA with the SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, initial owner 0 and name 0; store the returned handle in this+0x4.
If CreateMutexA returned a non-null handle, set the byte flag at this+0xC to 1.
Return the byte flag at this+0xC.
